title: GTA6 Release Nears: How Gamers Are Spending the Final Weekend
description: With less than two weeks until Rockstar's GTA6, gaming media and players are entering the final countdown. Check out what people are playing to pass the time.
author: GTA6 Hub Editorial
content:
## The Final Countdown to GTA6

Another week has come to a conclusion, and according to gaming media outlet Push Square, the gaming community is now very much in the GTA 6 "evacuation zone." With less than two weeks remaining until Rockstar's highly anticipated sequel drops, the atmosphere across the industry is palpable.

As anticipation reaches a fever pitch, players and editors alike find themselves in a unique transitional phase. When a blockbuster of the magnitude of GTA6 is right around the corner, picking a game to play for the weekend becomes an exercise in killing time and managing the overwhelming hype.

## Finding Solace in Portable Classics

How do you pass the final days before one of the biggest entertainment launches in history? For Push Square editor Jamie O'Neill, the answer involves dusting off a classic handheld.

Sharing weekend plans, O'Neill noted, "I've only managed about three hours on Lone Survivor: The Director's Cut, so I'll break out the PS Vita, because I can't leave that masked protagonist stuck in a disease riddled city, after all."

Turning to independent titles or older portable games is a classic way for gamers to keep busy during the pre-launch window, avoiding massive RPGs or open-world commitments that they won't have time to finish before diving headfirst into Rockstar's new world.

## Editor's Take

With less than two weeks to go, these final quiet weekends before GTA6 arrive are precious. Whether you are wrapping up backlog titles on a PS Vita or simply resting up, the gaming world is bracing for a monumental shift very soon.
